title: ESLint rule
description: Adds a project rule to tools/eslint-rules: rule, RuleTester spec, registration, path scoping in eslint.config.mjs and a lint-selftest case.

id.description: Rule id, kebab-case. It is registered as @app/<id>.

invariant.description: The invariant the rule guards, with its I-n, DC-n or ADR-n id.

description.description: Rule description and report message. Defaults to the invariant.

paths.description: Comma-separated top-level directories the rule applies to.
